label: Continuous-phase 2-FSK
about: A repeated, explicitly supplied bit pattern drives rectangular frequency pulses with continuous phase. Zero uses carrier minus deviation; one uses carrier plus deviation. No framing or decoded payload is inferred.
issue.pattern: Use a nonempty pattern of at most 256 zero/one characters.
